reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Lethal autonomous weapons and treaty ban
themes.definition: Concern about lethal autonomous weapons, including their potential acquisition by organized criminals, and support for a legally binding instrument to prohibit them.
themes.inclusion: Include passages on lethal autonomous weapons, AI-targeting drones, or calls for a treaty banning them.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic organized-crime or firearms passages that do not mention autonomous or AI-enabled weapons.
themes.boundary_cases: Autonomous weapons in the hands of non-state criminals are still coded here, and may also be coded AI_CYBER_SECURITY for criminal misuse.

examples.quote: we are even more alarmed at the potential for autonomous weapons to fall into the hands of organized criminals
He has urged nations to formulate a legally binding instrument by 2026 to prohibit lethal autonomous weapon systems.

themes.label: Responsible AI as equalizing development tool
themes.definition: Responsible AI and digital transformation framed as tools for productivity, innovation and sustainable development that can equalize opportunity.
themes.inclusion: Include statements presenting AI as a driver of productivity, innovation, or sustainable development.
themes.boundary_cases: The 'equalizing force' framing, if followed by warnings about a divide, is also coded AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: They can enhance productivity, innovation, and sustainable development for our people. Indeed, they can be an equalizing force for the world.

themes.label: AI must not create new global divide
themes.definition: Warning that AI could deepen old inequalities and create a new global divide.
themes.inclusion: Include warnings about AI-driven inequality between countries.
themes.exclusion: Exclude requests for infrastructure and skills support without inequality framing (AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING).
themes.boundary_cases: A single passage can carry both this code and AI_CAPACITY_BUILDING when the divide warning is followed by a support request.

examples.quote: We must therefore not allow AI to deepen old inequalities and create an entirely new global divide.

themes.label: Infrastructure, skills and capacity investment
themes.definition: Developing countries need investment in infrastructure, skills and capacity to benefit from AI.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for AI-related infrastructure, skills or capacity support for developing countries.
themes.exclusion: Exclude law-enforcement capacity building unrelated to AI.
themes.boundary_cases: Generic capacity requests are coded only when tied to AI or digital transformation in the passage.

examples.quote: Developing countries require investment in infrastructure, skills and capacity.

themes.label: Governance safeguarding privacy and data integrity
themes.definition: Calls for governance frameworks that protect privacy, intellectual property and data integrity and promote ethical AI use without stifling innovation, building on the Global Digital Compact.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for AI governance frameworks including specific safeguards.
themes.boundary_cases: References to the Pact for the Future and Global Digital Compact also qualify for AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: all countries require governance frameworks that safeguard privacy and intellectual property, ensure data integrity, and promote the ethical and responsible use of emerging technologies without stifling innovation

value.rationale: The two Caribbean passages share a security/crime context but differ: Antigua and Barbuda focuses on lethal autonomous weapons reaching criminals and supports a ban treaty, while Jamaica frames AI as a development equalizer requiring capacity support and governance safeguards.
